title: Reduction and Labeling of Oligosaccharides with Procainamide
author: Kimmy Park
materials: The excess labeling reagents are cleaned up using a size-exclusion PD MiniTrap G10 column: Add 140-240 µL 5% acetic acid to each sample (max PDG10 loading volume is 300 µL) Shake/vortex PDG-10 column to resuspend the stationary phase, then allow to settle while the column is vertical. Drain storage solution out of column Flush column with 2 mL 5% acetic acid (x3) Load sample and allow sample to enter the stationary phase fully Add 5% acetic acid so that (sample volume + this volume) = 0.7 mL. For example, if the sample is 140 µL, add 560 µL 5% acetic acid Allow the mobile phase to enter the bed fully. Add 600 µL 5% acetic acid, collect eluent.

steps.title: Prepare Labeling Solvent
steps.instruction: Mix a 7:3 (DMSO/acetic acid) solution (e.g., 700 µL DMSO and 300 µL acetic acid for 1 mL of solution).

steps.title: Weight Procainamide-HCl
steps.instruction: Weight the required amount of Procainamide-HCl based on the analyte of interest.

substeps.instruction: Weight 108 mg if the analyte is released N-glycans from an antibody.
Weight 216 mg if the analyte is oligosaccharides (this ratio can also be used for released N-glycans from cell pellets/antibody).

steps.title: Dissolve Procainamide-HCl
steps.instruction: Add the labeling solution to the weighted Procainamide-HCl and vortex until fully dissolved.

steps.title: Weight NaBH₃CN
steps.instruction: Weight the required amount of NaBH₃CN based on the analyte of interest.

substeps.instruction: Weight 63 mg if the analyte is released N-glycans from the antibody.
Weight 126 mg if the analyte is oligosaccharides (this ratio can also be used for released N-glycans from cell pellets/antibody).

steps.title: Prepare Final Labeling Solution
steps.instruction: Mix the ProA-HCl labeling solution with the weighted NaBH₃CN in a ventilated fume hood and vortex until fully dissolved.

substeps.instruction: If NaBH₃CN does not solubilize well, slowly add approximately 20 µL of water for every 6 mg of NaBH₃CN to aid solubilization.

steps.title: Prepare Analyte Sample
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 mg of oligosaccharides or N-glycans (released from 1 mg of glycoprotein) with 10 µL of water.

steps.title: Incubate Sample with Labeling Solution
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of the labeling solution to the solubilized oligosaccharides/released N-glycans and incubate at 37°C overnight.

steps.title: Quench Reaction
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of acetone to the mixture and heat at 65°C for 30 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Every 5 minutes, open the lid and sonicate for 10 seconds to release gas.

steps.title: Dry and Store Fractions
steps.instruction: Dry down the collected fractions via lyophilizer or SpeedVac prior to analysis or storage.

substeps.instruction: Store lyophilized labeled N-glycans or oligosaccharides at -80°C (stable for approximately 6 months).
